why: tests one prediction: collapse depends on total mutational events per replication, not on which source produces them. this mix (flaw 1/2000, copy 1/83, cosmic 1/167) is predicted at 0.95 events per replication, so it should collapse -- few generations, no self-sufficient replicator. if a pair with the same predicted load behaves differently, the prediction is wrong and the mixture matters after all
